basis: The E19 premise intentionally contains a fictional person painted on a cinema poster. The old empty-scene painter prompt forbade every human-shaped depiction, while the picture check could not distinguish a bounded drawing from a physically present stranger. Actual refused outputs omit the paper poster and show physical people.
change: Only an explicit flat-poster cue permits a fictional drawing inside all four visible paper edges attached to a wall; a separate positive vision verdict must confirm every human-shaped form is confined to that paper. A physical person, hand holding paper, unbounded painting, collage, missing verdict, text or incorrect action stays refused.
literal_cue: The painted figure stays entirely within the visible poster paper.
remaining: Generate and inspect the repaired poster scene; all current picture, voice, render and complete AV gates remain required.
